description: We are 112-PULSAR from Zaragoza, competing in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge! Our goal is to build PULSAR (Personal Unit for Learning, Support, Assistance & Reminders): your personal health companion in space. It is an offline health platform for astronauts on deep space missions that tracks vital signs and cabin conditions, estimates fatigue from the camera, and guides the crew through the next step when a reading goes out of range, in real time.
